title: XDL的武器1
description:
添加了几把武器和一些生物及一个BOSS
Added several weapons, some creatures, and a boss.
body: This mod adds several weapons, as detailed below: Ender Sword: Deals the same damage as a wooden sword but inflicts the annoying Levitation effect. Obtainable only by defeating Endermen. Assassin's Blade: Possesses extremely low durability but deals exceptionally high damage. Storm Axe: This is a powerful battleaxe that summons a storm upon slaying an enemy. Knight's Dull Sword: Attacking enemies with it inflicts the Dull effect. Obtainable only by defeating Emerald Knights. Additionally, one boss and one creature await player discovery.
